selection_method: Deterministic selection from computed P03 grids (no hand-picked values). For each variable x window, cells with the same significant trend class (+1 or -1, BH-FDR q < q_threshold) are grouped into 8-neighbour connected clusters; clusters with fewer than the documented minimum of eligible cells are dropped and cells with quality_flag >= 1 (schema 1.2, when the layer exists) are excluded. For 12-year windows the union of the window's own quality flag and the 2001–2024 quality flag of the same variable is used, because 12 annual values have little power to detect a sudden shift. Candidates are scored as area (sum of cos(latitude) weights) x median |standardized change per decade| x (1 - quality-flag share). Candidates in the full 2001–2024 window get a ranking bonus of x1.25, so a full-window candidate is preferred whenever its raw score is within 20% of a shorter-window candidate. specific_humidity in 2001–2012 is down-weighted by x0.5 because REAL_RUN_REVIEW records a documented early-period drop in that GLDAS field, so that artefact-like segment should not win on score alone. The selected set covers, when the evidence supports it, (a) an IMERG precipitation case, (b) both directions of the strongest same-variable opposite-direction pair, (c) a multi-variable pattern case (warming + drying preferred), and (d) one Southeast Asia case preferring Vietnam, then the Mekong box, then the rest; remaining slots are filled with the highest-scoring distinct variable/window candidates. Country-level candidates are added when a schema 1.2 country grid is present. Two caution cases are emitted: the local Vietnam air-temperature case when that country domain has a significant warming trend (all country cells included, flagged share reported), and the global specific-humidity witness-disagreement case. Every evidence number is an area-weighted aggregate of the underlying cell grids. When a second-witness agreement layer is available, finding scores are multiplied by (0.5 + 0.5 x corroborated share) so corroborated clusters win ties, and a finding whose cells are mostly contradicted (agreement code -2 share above 50%) is never selected. P06f: the opposite pair is used only when both sides have witness majority code 2 and contradicted area below 20%, with preference for precipitation, then 2001–2024, then other variables; the two sides must have different place labels, otherwise the pair is skipped and the reason is printed. Two caution cases are emitted: the local Vietnam air-temperature case and one global specific-humidity witness-disagreement case.

cases.title: Satellite rainfall is rising across China and Russia
cases.summary: Since 2001, satellite rainfall over China and Russia has risen by about 5.7 mm per month each decade across 168 grid cells.
cases.details: Selected by the deterministic cluster algorithm: 168 eligible cells of Precipitation with a significant increasing trend in 2001-2024 form a connected cluster (cos-latitude area 116.90). Median Sen slope +5.683 mm/month per decade; median q = 0.00586; 39% of the evaluated cells in its bounding box are significant; quality-flag share is 0%. Score = area x |standardized change| x (1 - flag share) = 20.001. It is one half of the strongest same-variable opposite-direction pair for Precipitation: the same variable has significant clusters of both signs in this window. Witness rule: finding scores are multiplied by (0.5 + 0.5 x corroborated share of 90%, factor 0.95) so corroborated clusters win ties, and a finding is never selected when its contradicted share (agreement code -2) is above 50% (here 0%).

cases.title: Warming and drying together across Algeria and Morocco
cases.summary: Since 2013, surface skin temperature over Algeria and Morocco has risen by about 1.2 °C each decade while root-zone soil moisture has fallen by about 1.6 kg m-2 each decade across 72 grid cells.
cases.details: Selected as the strongest connected pattern-1 cluster (warming and drying together) for Surface skin temperature and Root-zone soil moisture in 2013-2024. The cluster has 72 eligible cells (cos-latitude area 62.67); median slopes are +1.226 degC per decade and -1.646 kg m-2 per decade; median q = 0.0006 and 0.00121. 33% of the evaluated cells in its bounding box are significant; quality-flag share is 27%. Score = area x min(|standardized change|) x (1 - flag share).

cases.title: Vietnam is warming — but check the 2012 jump
cases.summary: Since 2001, GLDAS shows Vietnam warming by about 0.42 °C per decade, but 54% of the area jumps around 2012 inside a documented GLDAS input change. The independent MERRA-2 reanalysis sees the same year-to-year swings yet only +0.14 °C per decade (not significant) and almost no lasting shift after 2012 (+0.12 °C vs +0.73 °C), so much of this warming is more likely a data artefact.
cases.details: Caution case built from the whole Vietnam country domain: 30 evaluated cells of Near-surface air temperature in 2001-2024 (cos-latitude area 28.53), with flagged cells NOT excluded. Median Sen slope +0.4219 degC per decade; median q = 0.0017; 80% of the evaluated country cells are significant; quality-flag share is 54%; median break year is 2012.0. The documented GLDAS input change is 2008–2012. Score = area x |standardized change| x (1 - flag share) x significant share = 7.007. Lasting shift at 2012.0: main +0.73 °C vs witness +0.12 °C; annual-series correlation 0.61. This is the local caution case: it shows a significant country-wide trend whose cells are largely flagged, so the reader should check the evidence rather than treat the trend as a clean finding.

cases.title: Is the air drying? The second witness says no
cases.summary: Since 2001, GLDAS specific humidity falls across 41.6% of global land, while MERRA-2 reanalysis QV2M rises across 54.1%; 39.3% of GLDAS's significant area is contradicted by the witness.
cases.details: Global caution case for Specific humidity in 2001-2024: 5495 significant decreasing GLDAS cells (cos-latitude area 4366.18); median Sen slope -0.5201 g kg-1 per decade; median q = 0.000115; quality-flag share is 24%. GLDAS decreasing area is 41.6% of evaluated land; the independent MERRA-2 reanalysis QV2M increases over 54.1%; contradicted share is 39.3%. Witness majority code = -2. This is one of two caution cases: the significant GLDAS decrease is not corroborated by the independent witness, so read the evidence rather than treat the trend as a clean finding.
